🎙️ CISCO IQ ENABLEMENT SERIES

The IQ WAY – Cisco IQ Enablement

Onboarding & Collectors Mastery

01 • STRATEGY

Evolution Story — Legacy Challenges vs. Cisco IQ Vision & Outcomes

⚠️
The Legacy Challenges
Network Profile (NP)
Internal to Cisco only; lacked automated customer remediation and self-service context.

CX Cloud SaaS Limitations
Strictly SaaS-dependent. No sovereign or air-gapped sites.

• Tool Fragmentation & Overhead
Engineers balanced separate portals for contracts, PSIRTs, crash risks, and manual LDOS reports.
💡
The Cisco IQ Vision
Unified Intelligence
Consolidates asset telemetry, contract lifecycle, vulnerabilities, and proactive risk into one pane.

Deployment Sovereignty
Available as Cloud SaaS, Hybrid Tethered, and 100% On-Prem Air-Gapped appliance.

AI-First Paradigm
Built-in natural language AI Assistant enabling conversational querying over multi-domain topologies.
🚀
Operational Outcomes
  • ✔ Proactive Risk Mitigation: Identifies field notices, PSIRTs, and software bugs* before outages impact production.

  • ✔ Lifecycle & LDOS Optimization: Predictive planning for End-of-Sale, End-of-SW Maintenance, and Last Date of Support.

  • ✔ Accelerated TAC Resolution: Integrated diagnostics reduce MTTR by linking device logs directly to automated engineering rules.

  • ✔ Partner Empowerment: Enables partners to build custom managed services via standardized IQ APIs*.

  • ✔ Quantum-Safe Readiness: PQC hardware/software evaluation and crypto audits.

  • ✔ Peer Benchmarking: Risk posture and software adoption ranked against industry peers.

  • ✔ RIS Playbook Automation: Automated IOS XE upgrades and closed-loop risk remediation.

03 • ACCESS MANAGEMENT

User Access Levels

🔐
Access Tiers & Persona Definitions
Customer Access (Level 1 & Level 2)
  • • Level 1 (Basic/Guest): Limited portal view; cannot initiate onboarding.
  • • Level 2 (Entitled Customer): Active contract attached; full onboarding & workspace authority.

Partner  (Access Level 3)
  • • Delegated administrative access for partners.
  • • Multi-tenant customer workspace management with strict tenant boundary isolation.

Cisco Employee Access (Access Level 4)
  • • Technical Consulting Engineers, TAC & CX teams.
  • • CEC authentication granting cross-customer read/troubleshooting access based on engagement scope.
⚙️
Mandatory Prerequisites & Remediation Workflow
Mandatory Contract Attachment
Active CCO ID • Access Level 2/3 customers • Active attached service contracts (SNTC, LCS, Success Tracks).
Automated Gate Evaluation
Upon login, Cisco IQ queries the backend Entitlement API to verify contract binding.
Remediation Workflow
  • 1. Redirect user to Cisco Profile Management (id.cisco.com).
  • 2. Associate active Service Contract / Bill-to ID to CCO profile.
  • 3. Validate status in EPR Admin Tool.
  • 4. Wait ~24 hours for backend replication, then re-attempt onboarding.
🔍 Validation via EPR Admin Tool:
https://epr-admintool.cisco.com/adminTool/search

06 • ONBOARDING PATHS

Cisco IQ Onboarding — Greenfield vs. Brownfield Customers (SNTC, LCS, Success Tracks)

🌱
Greenfield Customer Ingestion (New Customers)
  • ✔ Direct Cloud Connectors: Direct API token integration with Cisco SD-WAN, Cisco Meraki Dashboard, Cisco Intersight.

  • ✔ Service Contracts Binding: Instant automatic inventory generation directly from Smart Account contract serial bindings.

  • ✔ Cisco IQ Link Deployment: Deploy on-prem IQ Link VM (ESXi/Hyper-V/KVM/Nutanix*) for automated local subnet sweeps (SNMPv3/CLI).

  • ✔ Clean Baseline Generation: Telemetry is normalized directly into the Unified Telemetry Schema (UTS) with zero duplicate records.

🔄
Brownfield Customer Migration (Existing Customers)
  • ✔ Existing CX Cloud / NP Migration*: Migrate historical asset databases, custom site tags, and past compliance records from CX Cloud and Network Profile.

  • ✔ CX Agent as Data Source: Embedded Catalyst Center CX Agent containers stream telemetry directly into Cisco IQ backend.

  • ✔ CSPC Appliance as Data Source: Existing CSPC collectors connect via bridge mode, preventing the need for immediate network rediscovery.

  • ✔ Deduplication & Delta Sync: Automated reconciliation engine deduplicates chassis serials and executes interim delta synchronization until cutover.
* In Roadmap

10 • SAAS MODEL

Cisco IQ SaaS Model (Cisco IQ Link)

☁️
Architecture & Specifications
✔ Target Audience
Customers allow data transmission via internet.
✔ Access & Setup
Direct login via Cisco.com (CCO ID).
✔ Key Features
  • • Automatic updates
  • • Bidirectional Data Flow
  • • Automatic rules mapping
  • • Live AI Assistant query engine
  • • Supports controllers like Catalyst Center and also non-controller devices

11 • AIR-GAPPED MODEL

Cisco IQ AIRGapped Model (Cisco IQ Virtual Appliance)

🛡️
Sovereign & Isolated Architecture
✔ Target Audience
Defense, Government, and BFSI with zero internet connectivity.
✔ Access & Setup
Deploy standalone Cisco IQ Virtual Appliance (VA) on ESXi / Hyper-V / KVM.
✔ Key Features
  • ✔ 100% local Unified Telemetry Schema (UTS) parsing
  • ✔ Local AI prompt evaluation (Local SLM / LLM)
  • ✔ Zero data exfiltration
  • ✔ Data remains strictly on-premises
